::: {#hero-heading}
This workshop is designed to provide the rationale for using evidence accumulation models on experiments involving perceptual judgements. Evidence accumulation models offer a comprehensive approach by jointly considering participants’ choices and response times. These models can also handle multiple-choice scenarios (two or more), allowing the analysis of responses in a broad range of tasks.
:::
